gates.requirement: Occurrence, semantic, and byte identities remain non-substitutable; equal semantics and equal bytes do not merge records.

SQLite records, lineage edges, events, artifact registrations, and dense registrations have the exact declared columns, uniqueness and foreign-key rules, and immutability triggers; their values are transactional or immutable as declared, reference-closed, canonical, ordered where applicable, and exactly matched to owned filesystem objects.

Zarr v3 arrays use canonical bounded dimension names and bind coordinates and every file or chunk to a deterministic manifest; manifest/store pairs and authoritative registrations form an exact closure; workspace and bundle verification repeat semantic checks, and bounded slices reject tampering.

Private bundles include only authoritative registered objects; require exact typed manifests, canonical event and lineage closure, and semantic Zarr verification; reject symlinks and special files; and remain deterministic, checksum-closed, relocatable, and preserving of extensions and withheld states.
P3 Python and CLI operations return the exact OperationResult envelope and normative exit classes.
